scheme_name: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for General Category (HRT-2)
other_conditions: Tools/equipment must be purchased from an authorised dealer of the empanelled manufacturer as notified by the Department of Agriculture
Companies empanelled for tarpaulin seats must follow the Department’s regulations
Companies empanelled for plastic crates must follow the Department’s regulations
Eligibility category noted in source: General Category
benefits_summary: Provides up to 75% assistance (maximum ₹3,750) for individual General Category farmers and up to 90% assistance (maximum ₹7,50,000) for farmer groups/cooperative societies for tools, equipment or PHM equipment.
